title: Whole number to decimal
prompt: The answer to a divided by b keeps its decimals: divide_as_decimal(7, 2) is 3.5.
starter:
func divide_as_decimal(a, b) -> float:
	return a / b
hints: Two ints divide to an int; convert one to a float first so the result is a float.

docs.name: float(value)
docs.what: Returns the value as a decimal number.

solution:
func divide_as_decimal(a, b) -> float:
	return float(a) / b
